The '''attack on the Imperial repair dock''' took place during the [[Operation Skyhook]]. The [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] design team was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Background==
Part of the shipment of military equipment [[Capture of the Sidral II|captured]] in the last operation passed through a repair facility near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] decided to launch an attack on the facility in the hopes of crippling the infrastructure that was servicing ships working on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

==The battle==
Despite the presence of many Imperial forces, a Rebel [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] squadron managed to penetrate the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. The Imperial repair dock was in fact a modified [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]]. Despite the heavy resistance, the Rebels attacked the Imperial forces. The Alliance forces managed to take out most of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]], along with the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class transports]] and [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttles]]. When the Imperials discovered the attack, the [[Vulture (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Vulture'']] was dispatched to save the facility. However, [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] eventually managed to destroy the [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]].
